title: CBS Complete Broadcast Day: D-Day
identity_notes: Preservation collection containing CBS Radio’s continuous D-Day broadcast day in 24 roughly hour-long sequential segments. These archive segments contain news bulletins, correspondent reports, relays and ordinary scheduled programming rather than 24 discrete historical series episodes.

eras.label: CBS D-Day complete broadcast day
eras.notes: Twenty-four preservation segments represent one continuous CBS broadcast day extending from early June 6 into early June 7.

historical_context.title: Coverage continues into June 7
historical_context.description: Internet Archive states the recording continues into early June 7; Part 24 is specifically described in secondary listening documentation as early June 7 BBC/London coverage.
